title: Magnate conspiracy
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Magnate conspiracy", at revision 1380641093, opens: "The Magnate conspiracy (also known as the Zrinski–Frankopan Conspiracy in Croatia, and the Wesselényi conspiracy in Hungary, was a plot among Croatian and Hungarian nobles to oust the Habsburg Monarchy from Croatia and Hungary, in response to the Treaty of Vasvár in 1664. This treaty – which ended the Fourth Austro-Turkish War – was highly unpopular in the Military Frontier, and those who were involved in the conspiracy intended to reopen hostilities with the Ottoman Empire after they broke away from Habsburg rule." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q255006, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "17th-century attempt to throw off Habsburg influence in Croatia and Hungary". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
